name: MRCB Bukit Jalil data centre
status_detail: Upcoming · announced June 2026; definitive agreements targeted Q3 2026
summary: MRCB's entry into the data centre business: a six-storey, AI-ready data centre on a 37,320 sq m leasehold site at Bukit Jalil Sentral, with an estimated gross development cost of RM2.1 billion.

scale.label: Site
scale.value: 37,320 sq m leasehold, Bukit Jalil Sentral

why_it_matters: A named, in-KL AI-ready campus from a local developer. Bukit Jalil sits inside the city, proving the data centre boom is not only a Johor or far-suburb story.
questions_to_follow: Are the definitive agreements executed on the Q3 2026 target?
Does the 65 MW capacity come online in phases, and when is the first phase?
Does the delivery timeline of 13 months from agreement hold?
location_precision: Area-level marker on the Bukit Jalil Sentral site. Exact building footprint unverified.

sources.title: MRCB To Develop RM2.1 Billion Data Centre In Bukit Jalil
MRCB diversifies into AI digital infra with RM2.1bil data centre venture in Bukit Jalil

history.event: Project announced; estimated gross development cost RM2.1 billion, target completion September 2026.
